name: basic-qc
title: Basic in-silico QC
description: Validate a sequence or FASTA, flag composition anomalies, and optionally review structure confidence. Not plate-assay QC. Research use only.

tasks.title: Validate input
tasks.description: Run analyze_sequence on the provided sequence or FASTA. Flag length and composition anomalies.

tasks.title: Structure check (protein)
tasks.description: If protein and length allows, optionally fold_protein and summarize PDB path. Open in structure workbench when available.

tasks.title: Document limitations
tasks.description: Clearly separate in silico checks from experimental QC. Note this is not 12-Plex or plate assay QC.
